Lausuntopyyntö: Ilmatilamääräykset vuodelle 2027
items.summary: Liikenne- ja viestintävirasto (Traficom) pyytää lausuntoja ehdotetuista muutoksista määräyksiin OPS M1-17 Radiovyöhykkeet, OPS M1-28 Vaara-alueet ja OPS M1-31 Transponderivyöhykkeet. Varsinaiset ilmatilamuutokset on lausutettu ja vahvistettu jo aiemmin Ilmatila 2027 -hankkeen ilmatilapaketin yhteydessä, joten tämän lausuntokierroksen tarkoituksena on esittää mahdollisia kommentteja määräysten teksteihin. Lausuntoaika päättyy vuodenvaihteessa, 31. joulukuuta 2026. Määräysmuutosten on tarkoitus tulla voimaan huhtikuun AIRAC-päivänä 15.4.2027.

items.title: Begäran om utlåtande: Luftrumsföreskrifterna för år 2027
items.summary: Transport- och kommunikationsverket (Traficom) begär utlåtanden om de föreslagna ändringarna i luftfartsföreskrifterna OPS M1-17 Luftrum med krav på dubbelriktad radioförbindelse, OPS M1-28 Farliga områden och OPS M1-31 Luftrum med transponderkrav. De egentliga ändringarna i luftrummet har redan tidigare varit på remiss och fastställts i samband med projektet Luftrum 2027. Syftet med denna remissrunda är därför att ge möjlighet att lämna eventuella synpunkter på själva föreskriftstexterna. Remisstiden går ut vid årsskiftet, den 31 december 2026. Ändringarna i föreskrifterna är avsedda att träda i kraft på AIRAC-datumet den 15 april 2027.

items.title: Monaco: matkustustiedote
items.summary: Monaco: matkustustiedote Turvallisuustaso Noudata tavanomaista varovaisuutta Muut turvallisuustason tiedot Monaco on turvallinen matkailumaa. UM:n matkustustiedotteet ovat suosituksia Vastaat matkapäätöksestäsi aina itse. Paikallisilla viranomaisilla on ensisijainen vastuu kaikkien maan alueella oleskelevien ihmisten turvallisuudesta ja hätätilanteissa etsintä- ja pelastustoimista. Kriisitilanteissa noudata paikallisten viranomaisten ohjeita. Seuraa uutisointia tiedotusvälineissä sekä tiedotusta edustuston verkkosivuilla ja sosiaalisen median kanavissa. Ulkoministeriö ja Suomen ulkomaanedustustot avustavat suomalaisia konsulipalvelulain mukaisesti. Mikäli Euroopan unionin ulkopuolisessa kohdemaassa ei ole Suomen edustustoa, voit kääntyä muiden EU-maiden edustustojen puoleen. Matkatoimiston järjestämällä matkalla olevaa avustaa ensisijaisesti matkanjärjestäjä. Konsulipalvelulaki Konsulisuojeludirektiivi Laki matkapalveluyhdistelmistä Suosittelemme aina matkavakuutuksen ottamista. Tarkista ennen matkaasi matkavakuutuksesi kattavuus ja voimassaolo erityisesti jos sinulla on jokin sairaus, olet raskaana, matkasi suuntautuu vaarallisille alueille tai harrastat riskialttiita lajeja, Sairastuneen tai vainajan kotiuttaminen on kallista ja vaikea järjestää ilman kattavaa matkavakuutusta, eikä hoitoa aina saa ulkomailla ilman maksusitoumusta tai ennakkomaksua. Tee matkustusilmoitus osoitteessa https://matkustusilmoitus.fi/ Jos passisi katoaa tai varastetaan, tee siitä ilmoitus paikalliselle poliisiasemalle. Mikäli kohdemaassa ei ole Suomen edustustoa, hae hätämatkustusasiakirjaa (ETD = Emergency Travel Document) toisen EU-maan edustustosta. Ota kopiot tärkeimmistä asiapapereista kuten passista ja lentolipuista. Säilytä ne erillään alkuperäisistä. Terveys Monaco ei kuulu Euroopan unioniin, eikä eurooppalainen sairaanhoitokortti kelpaa Monacossa. Selvitä ennakkoon matkakohteesi tartuntatautitilanne ja rokotussuositukset. Löydät ne seuraavien viranomaisten verkkosivuilta: Matkailijan terveysopas Maailman terveysjärjestö WHO Euroopan tartuntatautivirasto Maan lait ja käytännöt Valokuvaamiseen ja videokuvaamiseen liittyy monissa maissa rajoituksia. Mahdollisia kuvauskieltoja on syytä noudattaa. Yleensä esim. sotilaallisten laitosten, lentokenttien tai satamien valokuvaaminen ja videokuvaaminen on kielletty, ja kielto koskee myös ilmakuvausta drooneilla. Myös droonien maahantuonti voi vaatia erillisiä lupaprosesseja. Varmista tarvittaessa rajoitukset etukäteen paikallisviranomaisilta. Kiellettyjä kohteita kuvaava henkilö saatetaan ottaa kiinni tai pidättää, ja kuvauslaitteet saatetaan tuhota tai takavarikoida. Maahantulosäännökset Paikallisviranomaisten tiedotusta voi seurata alla olevista linkeistä: Monacon sisäministeriö Monacon poliisihallinto UM ei vastaa vieraiden valtioiden maahantulosäännöksistä, kuten passin voimassaoloa koskevista ehdoista tai viisumivelvollisuudesta. Varmista ajantasaiset maahantulosäädökset kohdemaan viranomaisilta, esimerkiksi maan lähimmästä edustustosta. Lue lisää Suomen kansalaisen matkustusasiakirjoista osoitteessa https://um.fi/passi/ Pariisin-suurlähetystö 75007 PARIS FRANCE http://finlande.fr http://facebook.com/AmbassadeFinlandeParis http://twitter.com/AmbFinlandePAR http://instagram.com/finlande.fr Päivystys: Hätätapauksissa ota yhteys ulkoministeriön päivystykseen: puhelin +358 9 1605 5555 ja sähköposti paivystys.um@gov.fi.

Yleensä esim. sotilaallisten laitosten, lentokenttien tai satamien valokuvaaminen ja videokuvaaminen on kielletty, ja kielto koskee myös ilmakuvausta drooneilla. Myös droonien maahantuonti voi vaatia erillisiä lupaprosesseja. Varmista tarvittaessa rajoitukset etukäteen paikallisviranomaisilta. Kiellettyjä kohteita kuvaava henkilö saatetaan ottaa kiinni tai pidättää, ja kuvauslaitteet saatetaan tuhota tai takavarikoida.

Ukrainan energiatukirahasto tukee Venäjän hyökkäysten vaurioittaman energiainfrastruktuurin korjaamista, energiantuotannon ja -jakelun ylläpitämistä sekä energiajärjestelmän modernisointia. items.title: Microsoft mega outage: Report reveals testing gaps and emails that never arrived
items.summary: Some emails never reached their recipients during November's Microsoft 365 outage, the company has confirmed in a final report that also exposes gaps in its testing and recovery procedures. The post-incident report details how a Windows defect brought down Exchange Online and disrupted features across other Microsoft 365 services. For affected users, the cloud became someone else's unavailable computer. A preliminary report had already blamed a July code change, combined with a failover and reduced capacity. The final report confirms those findings and sets out Microsoft's plans to improve change auditing and recovery procedures, and add spare capacity. The defect affected Microsoft's gateway server configuration, not standard Windows deployments. The epic outage (named the "Microsoft long weekend" by some wags) kicked off on November 12 and wasn't fully resolved until November 14. Microsoft extended its delivery retry window to 48 hours, but some delayed messages destined for consumer mailboxes inactive for more than 30 days still expired, generating non-delivery reports. The company said all queued enterprise messages were eventually delivered, with none found permanently lost. The report is grim, particularly in how the failure ramped up as US users came online to find gateway servers toppling over. At the worst point, more than 80 percent of North American gateway servers were unresponsive.

items.title: Apache Solr: Ping health-check endpoint could trigger unintended functionality
items.summary: Classification: Severe, Solution: Official Fix, Exploit Maturity: Not Defined, CVSSv3.1: 8.8, CVEs: CVE-2026-86312, Summary: Under some configurations a request to the ping endpoint could carry out more than a simple health check. In deployments that rely on Solr's rule-based authorization, a client granted only the low-privilege health permission could thereby trigger behavior that should require higher privileges; where the shipped security.json template leaves the health permission unauthenticated, no credentials are required at all. This issue affects Apache Solr from 9.0.0 through the releases preceding the fixed versions. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 9.11.0 or 10.1.0, which resolve the issue. You are affected if you run an affected version and allow the /admin/ping endpoint to be reached with only the health permission. This includes the default sample security configuration installed by the bin/solr CLI, where that endpoint is unauthenticated. Users who cannot upgrade immediately should restrict access to the /admin/ping endpoint in their authorization configuration — for example by requiring a trusted role for that path — and ensure Solr is not reachable from untrusted clients or networks, as recommended for all Solr deployments.

items.title: Behind the Alias: How One Researcher Unmasked a Decade of Ransomware Actors
items.summary: It's a now-familiar scenario: "Warning" abruptly displays on the computer screen as the system locks down. A ransom note follows, threatening data extortion and continued disruptions if a demand is not met. But while it may seem sudden in the moment, the attack was the final step in what may have been years of planning, all carried out by a sprawling, interconnected network of underground actors. The ransomware ecosystem is more complicated than it appears on the surface. But a new framework based on an identity graph analysis, developed by Flare threat researcher Assaf Morag, aims to help defenders and law enforcement take a more proactive approach to ransomware risk by better understanding who they're up against. When applied during research, the framework can be used to uncover the inner workings of these operations, including indicators of compromise (IoCs) that are critical to incident-response investigations. Researchers can also use it to find connections between various threat actors and groups, which is increasingly important as new groups emerge each year.

When applied during research, the framework can be used to uncover the inner workings of these operations, including indicators of compromise (IoCs) that are critical to incident-response investigations. Researchers can also use it to find connections between various threat actors and groups, which is increasingly important as new groups emerge each year.

items.title: CISA flags critical Cisco RCE flaw as actively exploited in attacks
items.summary: ​The US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) warned federal agencies that attackers are now exploiting a recently patched critical Cisco Expressway vulnerability in the wild. Cisco Expressway Series devices are enterprise collaboration gateways (deployed as virtual machines or physical hardware appliances) that connect internal voice and video systems with outside networks and remote users via a secure connection. Tracked as CVE-2026-76466, this security flaw stems from the use of hard-coded credentials and a failure to fully validate client certificates, enabling unauthenticated attackers to remotely execute arbitrary operating system commands as root on affected Cisco Expressway-C and Cisco Expressway-E devices configured in a cluster. "An attacker with possession of the cookies could exploit this vulnerability by connecting to the database service and invoking specific remote procedure call (RPC) commands," Cisco said in late October, when it released security patches to address the issue. While Cisco says that its Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT) is not aware of active exploitation in the wild or publicly available proof-of-concept exploits targeting this vulnerability, CISA tagged it as actively exploited on Friday. The cybersecurity agency also added it to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) Catalog on Tuesday and ordered US Federal Civilian Executive Branch (FCEB) agencies to secure their systems within three days, as mandated by Binding Operational Directive (BOD) 26-04. Although BOD 26-04 targets only federal agencies, CISA urged all network defenders, including private-sector security teams, to prioritize patching this flaw to block ongoing attacks that may target their networks.

items.title: Agentic Attacks: In The Wild
items.summary: Wiz Research has been closely monitoring the evolving role of Agentic Offensive Frameworks in the threat landscape. We first covered this trend in our disclosure of attempts by Storm-0940, a Chinese-state aligned actor, to use ARTEX to conduct supply chain compromises into other software sectors. The next week, we shared the recurring fingerprints of agentic activity based on public and private cases. Then we closed out last month by sounding the alarm on Black October for AI Developer Platforms - linking nine disclosed incidents in an agentic attack trend. We’ve also worked with our internal partners at Google Threat Intelligence Group in their coverage of Agentic Offensive Frameworks and the Significant Threshold that Agentic Threat Activity has crossed. There has been explosive growth in successful agentic attacks, just in the last three weeks. Since publishing the Black October post, an additional twenty related incidents have been disclosed by vendors. Wiz’s CIRT has seen a 3x increase in engagement requests, matching the trend across the industry of overwhelming IR demand.

items.title: Xen Orchestra: Empty-object login token
items.summary: Classification: Critical, Solution: Official Fix, Exploit Maturity: Functional, CVSSv3.1: 9.8, CVEs: CVE-2026-133469, Summary: XO (Xen Orchestra) is a solution to visualize, manage, backup and delegate your XCP-ng (or XenServer) infrastructure. Prior to 6.9.2 and 6.10.1, REST cookie parsing turns authenticationToken=j:%7B%7D into {}. REST authentication passes that object to the XO token provider without requiring a string. The token collection treats {} as an unfiltered lookup and returns its first token; the provider authenticates as that token's owner if it is unexpired. The authenticated /rest/v0/users/me/authentication_tokens route then returns reusable login token IDs. This vulnerability is actively exploited in the wild. This vulnerability is fixed in 6.9.2 and 6.10.1.

items.title: Attackers Exploit CVEs to Harvest Credentials
items.summary: Key takeaways: - Credential-harvesting attempts appeared across 127 of 694 CVEs observed in VulnCheck Canaries (18%), with monthly records rising roughly sixfold from July to October. - Open source software, AI products and developer tools accounted for 61% of the CVEs associated with credential-harvesting attempts. - Attackers search application files, logs and environment variables for database passwords, cloud credentials and API keys, with file-read and SSRF vulnerabilities providing opportunities without code execution. - VulnCheck observed 1,756 attempts targeting AI provider and coding agent credentials from 406 IP addresses across 27 CVEs. - Medium-severity vulnerabilities represented just 6% of the CVEs associated with harvesting attempts but generated 23% of harvesting records. - Defenders should prioritize vulnerabilities that expose secrets, restrict access to credential files and cloud metadata, and routinely rotate and monitor application, cloud and AI credentials. For a few months, a lot of my research has focused on the exploitation tactics attackers use across VulnCheck Canaries. When I researched Langflow, I noticed it was being targeted in credential harvesting operations. A few weeks ago, Microsoft published research about attackers grabbing keys from GitHub, and the IOCs from that report showed up in attacks on our Canaries, which also showed credential harvesting. So naturally, I thought it would be interesting to explore just how broad credential harvesting is across VulnCheck Canaries, which technologies are being targeted, and what types of keys threat actors are going after.
items.summary_html:
Key takeaways:
- Credential-harvesting attempts appeared across 127 of 694 CVEs observed in VulnCheck Canaries (18%), with monthly records rising roughly sixfold from July to October.
- Open source software, AI products and developer tools accounted for 61% of the CVEs associated with credential-harvesting attempts.
- Attackers search application files, logs and environment variables for database passwords, cloud credentials and API keys, with file-read and SSRF vulnerabilities providing opportunities without code execution.
- VulnCheck observed 1,756 attempts targeting AI provider and coding agent credentials from 406 IP addresses across 27 CVEs.
- Medium-severity vulnerabilities represented just 6% of the CVEs associated with harvesting attempts but generated 23% of harvesting records.
- Defenders should prioritize vulnerabilities that expose secrets, restrict access to credential files and cloud metadata, and routinely rotate and monitor application, cloud and AI credentials.

For a few months, a lot of my research has focused on the exploitation tactics attackers use across VulnCheck Canaries. When I researched Langflow, I noticed it was being targeted in credential harvesting operations. A few weeks ago, Microsoft published research about attackers grabbing keys from GitHub, and the IOCs from that report showed up in attacks on our Canaries, which also showed credential harvesting. So naturally, I thought it would be interesting to explore just how broad credential harvesting is across VulnCheck Canaries, which technologies are being targeted, and what types of keys threat actors are going after.

items.title: Norway links energy firm cyberattacks to critical Azure API Management flaw
items.summary: Microsoft has issued a critical vulnerability advisory after attackers were caught raiding Azure API Management (APIM) instances for secrets and performing admin operations. According to a nonpublic advisory, seen by The Register, Microsoft said the attacks, which have already affected two major energy companies, only impact customers on Azure API Management Classic tiers, not Azure API Management v2. It said of the now-patched vuln: "Our investigation found that customers were exposed and an unauthorized party could have used the issue to access secrets stored in Azure API Management Classic instances before Microsoft identified the security issue." Microsoft linked exposure to Classic-tier configurations that did not follow its network security guidance or stored secrets directly in APIM rather than referencing them from Azure Key Vault. Microsoft directs customers to its security guidance for the recommended configuration. The advisory lists potentially exposed secrets, including named values, client secrets associated with identity providers and OpenID Connect providers, subscription keys, and tokens used to call direct management APIs.
